decisions.reason: The DPA management tool fits the firm's agency and compliance focus, kept its own page through 2024 with positive customer feedback, and costs little to carry given the firm's growth and slack.
As the flagship platform shown on the home page in both years, it meets the firm's aspirations and anchors its agency-focused direction, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The configurable managed plan sits close to the core hosting business and stayed visible on its own page, suggesting satisfactory results; at most it may be merged or renamed rather than dropped.

Extended PHP security support is cheap to provide and matches the security and compliance promise, but its thin web presence and time-bound nature tied to PHP version lifecycles make it a moderate candidate for retirement.
